messages:
Ivy: quick follow-up from RFC: we need an explicit edge<->central handshake for lease handoff. main goal: avoid double-admit and keep billing correct.

Rahul: agree. Proposal: edge emits admit_hint + provisional_id for token path. If central converts to lease later, it returns canonical_lease_id and ingest pipeline dedupes by provisional_id -> canonical.

Bea: sounds good. What about failure modes if central never responds? edge should expire provisional_id and not reissue a lease later to avoid ghost billing.

Ivy: expiration TTL on provisional_id + tombstone writes on central when revoked. Also emit event provisional_revoked so billing can reconcile.

Rahul: API shape: POST /admit {client, hints} -> {admit:true, mode:"token"|"provisional", provisional_id:"p-123", ttl_ms:"5000"}. Later: PUT /confirm {provisional_id} -> {status:"leased", lease_id:"L-456"} or {status:"revoked"}.

Bea: prefer minimal fields to keep proxies small. Also require admit_id in forward headers so downstream services can tag logs.

Ivy: telemetry list: admit_mode, provisional_age_ms, confirm_latency_ms, provisional_revoked_count. Alert if confirm_latency_ms p99 > 2000ms.

infra-bot: created calendar event "Admit handshake design sync" Fri 11:00 PT.

Rahul: owners: eng-platform Rahul+Ivy, eng-infra Bea. Plan: spike 1w, prototype 2w, canary 1w. I'll doc the dedupe semantics for billing.

Ivy: I'll open follow-up RFC with the API sketches, runbook items, and a short test matrix (central down, delayed confirm, provisional collisions).
